argument: Any source-feasible five-bracket/two-cog layout supplies all seven active mappings under the previously audited necessity proof. Assign all six inactive insert slots jointly from the positive control, with presence zero. Every cross geometry/order inequality is disabled, every optional insert interval is absent, and each active/dummy table freely extends every active variant. All remaining joint dummy constraints pass on that fixed control. The59 first-sheet originals explicitly include every removed insert. Complete active poses may be relabelled by coarse X. No active anchor, orientation or legal cog angle is fixed.
